note: Deferred or unresolved leads preserved honestly. Nothing here is claimed as verified. Status values: DEFERRED (worthwhile, out of v1 scope), UNVERIFIED (needed before a dependent decision), UNREAD (fetch failed or content not machine-readable this session), UNEXECUTED (proposed check not run).

leads.title: Mergin Maps synchronisation/conflict mechanism (whole-product precedent)
leads.why_relevant: Closest whole-product analogue to the brief's bundle-exchange workflow; likely documents an explicit conflict-file approach for diverged QGIS projects.
leads.evidence_state: Docs shell captured (sources.json S13); VitePress body not machine-read; raw markdown 404 on master and main. No conflict-mechanism claim was drawn from it.
leads.next_step: Locate the docs source repository (or fetch the VitePress content chunk) and read the conflict-file description; compare with the proposal's oplog contract.

leads.title: OGC GeoPackage as single-file project container (alternative B)
leads.why_relevant: Standard container for tiles+features could replace the custom SQLite+MBTiles bundle; likely better interoperability with QGIS/GDAL ecosystems.
leads.evidence_state: Not investigated this session; no license or extension audit performed; the proposal blocks v1 adoption on that audit.
leads.next_step: Read the GeoPackage spec's extension/RTree provisions and the implementer license terms; compare projection-metadata (gpkg_spatial_ref_sys) handling with the proposal's transform descriptors.

leads.title: CRDT-based merge (e.g. Automerge family) — opt-in alternative A
leads.why_relevant: Automatic convergence for peer sync; a later real-time collaboration lane.
leads.evidence_state: Not investigated; v1 rejects it as default because the brief requires inspectable conflicts and W2 shows the silent-loss hazard of naive automatic merges.
leads.next_step: If real-time sync is pursued, evaluate CRDT conflict semantics (concurrent delete vs edit) against the brief's 'no silent loss' requirement.

leads.title: OSM Tile Usage Policy exact limits
leads.why_relevant: Gate for any bulk tile extraction/bundling code; OSMF links it from the copyright page (S11) and states no free third-party tile service.
leads.evidence_state: Fetch attempt failed once with a tool boundary error (OSError); URL pinned: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/
leads.next_step: Retry capture; record bulk-download rules before writing any tile-fetch tooling.

leads.title: QField / QFieldCloud delta-based offline sync
leads.why_relevant: Second whole-product precedent family for project-copy reconciliation in the QGIS ecosystem.
leads.next_step: Read QFieldCloud delta/conflict documentation; compare divergence bookkeeping with the proposal's base_rev scheme.

leads.title: ODK / KoboToolbox form-driven field collection
leads.why_relevant: Different mechanism family (form-first rather than map-first) for offline observation capture; relevant to form design and media attachment patterns.
leads.next_step: Review ODK XForms/instance attachment handling for photo/hash/id patterns.

leads.title: MapLibre GL JS offline rendering
leads.why_relevant: Candidate rendering engine for MBTiles/vector basemaps on tablets; opportunity lane for broad map-source support.
leads.next_step: Verify offline/mbtiles:// source support and license in the bound version.

leads.title: SpatiaLite as spatial layer alternative to R*Tree
leads.why_relevant: Alternative spatial index/function family with geometry functions; could replace the R*Tree + exact-filter two-stage query.
leads.next_step: Compare function coverage and build/portability burden against the R*Tree design.

leads.title: GeoPackage RTree extension
leads.why_relevant: Bridges leads L2/L8: indexed geometry inside a standard container.
leads.next_step: Read the gpkg RTree extension trigger behavior before any GeoPackage adoption.

leads.title: SQLite WAL/backup/recovery specifics
leads.why_relevant: Underpins the interrupted-save/merge recovery contract (validation item 4).
leads.evidence_state: Recovery design relies on staging + commit markers plus documented rtreecheck (S1 §7.2) and changeset abort semantics (S12 §2.2); WAL crash behavior itself was not documented-sourced here.
leads.next_step: Capture sqlite WAL documentation; implement and run the SIGKILL recovery suite.

leads.title: pyproj version binding follow-through (3.7.2 → ≥3.8.0)
leads.why_relevant: always_xy on from_pipeline exists only from 3.8.0 (PR #1566, milestone 3.8.0; S6/S7); stable docs today are 3.7.2 (S3); open defect #1644 targets 3.8.1.
leads.why_relevant_extra: If ≥3.8.0 is unavailable on a platform, fall back to from_crs-based construction (always_xy since 2.2.0, S3).
leads.evidence_state: Release binding established from PR metadata; actual wheel availability per platform not checked.
leads.next_step: Verify wheel availability for the target OS set; re-check assumptions invalidated by the 3.8.1 fix for #1644.

leads.title: Discrete global grid systems (H3/S2) as viewport index alternative
leads.why_relevant: Different index mechanism family for bounded spatial access; potential simplification of cache invalidation.
leads.evidence_state: Not investigated; R*Tree precedent (S1) chosen for v1.
leads.next_step: Only if R*Tree operational costs (rebuild, roundoff handling) prove problematic at 250k.
